bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education; appropriating money for suicide prevention curriculum.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

Subdivision 1.

Department of Health.

The sum indicated in this section is appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Health for the fiscal year designated.

Subd. 2.

Suicide prevention curriculum.

(a) For a grant to the Division of Indian Work to develop suicide prevention curriculum:

$

.......

.....

2026

(b) The Division of Indian Work must use the grant award to develop and pilot culturally specific suicide prevention curriculum for Native American youth. The curriculum must engage students in topics of mental health, emotional intelligence, and depression and suicide to increase understanding of mental wellness and provide practical tools for supporting themselves and others through painful times.

(c) This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: The sum indicated in this section is appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Health for the fiscal year designated.
(a) For a grant to the Division of Indian Work to develop suicide prevention curriculum:

(b) The Division of Indian Work must use the grant award to develop and pilot culturally specific suicide prevention curriculum for Native American youth. The curriculum must engage students in topics of mental health, emotional intelligence, and depression and suicide to increase understanding of mental wellness and provide practical tools for supporting themselves and others through painful times.
